unit.sep: Construct corresponding images and verify dimensional scale relationships.
unit.careers: Illustrative mathematical model making and design planning;no real-site survey or professional qualification.
unit.focus: Similarity,centres,enlargement/reduction,signed coordinate factors,positive physical length/area/volume ratios,model applications and a conditional cube-making project.
unit.content: Similarity; Enlargement; Scale Factors; Application of Similarity and Enlargement
unit.phenomenon: A fictional model label doubles all dimensions but claims only double area and volume,and another accepts equal volumes as proof of similarity.
unit.supportingPhenomena: Corresponding vertex rays,nonorigin reductions,negative-factor images,geometric measure ratios and ideal-versus-made cube pairs.
unit.drivingQuestion: How are similarity and enlargement applied in day-to-day life?
unit.storylineThread: Similarity conditions→centre→positive image→reduction→signed factor→area→volume→inverse ratios→model units→design→actual making→audit/usefulness→independent evidence.
unit.coreCompetencies:
Communication and Collaboration: the learner discusses and recognises similar objects from their immediate environment.
Creativity and Imagination: the learner makes models of solids of different sizes using similarity and enlargement concepts.
unit.values:
Responsibility: the learner collects and takes care of objects from the immediate environment to recognise those that are similar and discusses what makes them similar.
Integrity: the learner makes models with accurate measurements, adhering to the concept of similarity and enlargement.
unit.pcis:
Social Cohesion: the learner works in a group to create models of various similar solids.
Education for Sustainable Development (environmental education): the learner collects and uses objects from the immediate environment and discusses with peers to recognise those that are similar.

sections.title: 1. Determine and construct an enlargement
sections.prompt: From the CSE13matched vertex data,draw AA′ andBB′ to determine the centre and linear scale factor,checking both pairs. Separately construct the stated triangle’s factor1/2image about the origin on equal-unit axes;label every image coordinate and explain one centre-to-point check. Use only the final data.
sections.exemplar: AA′lies ony=1andBB′ony=2x−1;centre(1,1). A′B′/AB=4/2=2,andboth centre-to-point ratios agree. Separate imagesP′(1,1),Q′(3,1),R′(1,2);each is halfway from the origin to its original point. Equal axis units and labelled corresponding vertices are required.

sections.title: 2. Determine area and volume scale factors
sections.prompt: For the two CSE13similar cuboids,calculate each total surface area and volume,with units. Find the large/small length,area and volume ratios and explain how the three ratios relate. Do not mix surface and volume units.
sections.exemplar: Small surface2(6+8+12)=52cm²,large2(24+32+48)=208cm²,ratio4. Small volume24cm³,large192cm³,ratio8. Common positive length ratio2;area ratio2²andvolume ratio2³. All corresponding lengths double,so the supplied similarity assumption and formulas agree.

sections.title: 3. Recover and relate physical scale factors
sections.prompt: For the CSE13similar solids with surface areas9cm²and225cm²,find the positive large/small length ratio and infer their volume ratio. Separately,for similar solids with volumes8cm³and27cm³,find the positive length and surface-area ratios. State why similarity and ratio direction are needed.
sections.exemplar: Surface ratio225/9=25giveslength ratio√25=5andvolume ratio5³=125. Separate volume ratio27/8giveslength ratio3/2andarea ratio9/4. The relationships require geometrically similar solids and consistently large/small corresponding measures;ratios alone do not establish similarity.

Give the actual/model area ratio using matching units and explain why50alone is wrong for area. Write a short reasoned advice statement linking a checked result to a concrete useful scale decision and a similarity,unit,measurement or idealisation limit. sections.exemplar: Actual dimensions200cmby300cm=2mby3m,area6m². In matching units60000cm²/24cm²=2500=50².
